templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from control-loop by the note-writer: three side-by-side lifecycle columns (Initialization, Runtime, Management) numbered 1-7 with no return arrow or cycle anywhere; this is a phase-lanes lifecycle figure, not control-loop.
templates.what_to_learn: Number steps continuously across adjacent lifecycle columns (1-3 in column one, 4-6 in column two, 7 in column three) instead of restarting the count per column, so the reader can tell setup, runtime, and management apart while still reading one global sequence.
